title: Ion Drive Sunglasses Heist
description: The player pilots a stolen ion drive engine through a neon-lit asteroid corridor, collecting floating sunglasses as power-up tokens. Each collected pair of sunglasses boosts the engine's thrust and applies a visual tint filter. The player must collect at least 5 sunglasses while dodging obstacles to reach the escape warp gate.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a third-person space heist mini-game. Load PrimaryIonDrive.glb as the player-controlled spaceship and SunglassesKhronos.glb as collectible power-up tokens. Camera setup: place a PerspectiveCamera with FOV 60 behind and slightly above the ion drive, following it smoothly with lerp-based tracking. Use a dark space skybox color (0x050510) with ambient light intensity 0.3 and a blue-white directional light. Add a subtle PointLight on the ion drive's exhaust area colored orange. Spawn 8 instances of the sunglasses model at random positions along a Z-axis corridor stretching 200 units forward, each rotating slowly on their Y-axis and bobbing with a sine wave. Scatter 12 simple red BoxGeometry obstacles randomly in the corridor. The ion drive moves forward automatically at a base speed of 0.3 units per frame. The player steers left and right using A/D or arrow keys, and can boost speed temporarily by pressing Shift. Implement collision detection using bounding spheres: when the ion drive intersects a sunglasses model, remove it from the scene, increment a collection counter displayed in an HTML overlay, increase base speed by 0.05, and apply a brief screen tint effect using a semi-transparent colored fullscreen div that fades out over 500ms. When colliding with a red obstacle, flash the screen red and reduce speed by 0.1 (minimum 0.1). Place a large green wireframe TorusGeometry at Z=-210 as the warp gate. When the player reaches the gate with 5 or more sunglasses collected, display a victory message. If they arrive with fewer than 5, display a retry prompt. Add a HUD overlay showing current speed, sunglasses collected out of 8, and distance remaining to the gate. All interaction requires at least 8 steps: steer to avoid first obstacle, collect first sunglasses, steer to avoid second obstacle, use boost, collect additional sunglasses reaching 5 total, dodge late obstacles, validate collection count meets threshold, and cross the warp gate. Validate that speed stays within bounds 0.1 to 0.8 and collection count is between 0 and 8.
